# variant that existed then. Generated at 90359ed5 (rust-dashcore dev right before #1156)
# with bincode 2's standard configuration, the encoding Dash Platform's wallet store uses.
# Most transactions come from Dash Platform's wallet-storage fixture (rows written at
# 40268cc0 and 6c5775cf), the quorum commitment from a Core v24 devnet block, the rest are
# built for the file.
